meta.name: how-to-tutorial-writer
meta.description: Write how-to guides and tutorials that naturally integrate affiliate product recommendations. Triggers on: "write a how-to guide", "tutorial for [task]", "step by step guide to [goal]", "how to [verb] with [product]", "write a tutorial blog post", "guide on how to [task]", "beginner guide to [topic]", "walkthrough for [product]", "write an educational article", "how do I [task] blog post", "write a tutorial that promotes [product]".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出带产品推荐的教程指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一边写教程一边自然地推荐产品获取佣金
copy.tagline_en: Write how-to guides with product recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write tutorials while naturally promoting affiliate products for commissions

howto.what: Claude 会充当教程写手，自动搜索信息、规划结构，撰写带有联盟产品推荐的逐步教程文章，输出可直接发布的 Markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当你要求写“如何做某事”指南、教程或操作步骤，且需要教育内容驱动产品推广时触发。触发短语如“write a how-to guide”、“tutorial for [task]”等。

写一份关于自动化社交媒体帖子的操作指南。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a tutorial writer: it researches, plans, and writes step-by-step guides with natural affiliate product recommendations, outputting ready-to-publish Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a how-to guide, tutorial, or walkthrough, especially for educational content that promotes affiliate products. Example triggers: "write a how-to guide", "tutorial for [task]", etc.

say_en.text: Write a tutorial on how to create AI avatar videos with HeyGen.
say_en.note: Claude produces a full step-by-step guide with HeyGen affiliate links.

say_en.text: Write a how-to guide for automating social media posts.
